theme.en: AI Expansion Redraws Memory and Supply Chains
theme.zh: AI扩张重塑存储与供应链

dek.en: TSMC reportedly considers advanced memory production as Groq targets an $8 billion valuation. Acquisitions, tighter chip tracking and efforts to improve system reliability show AI expansion reshaping suppliers and deployment choices.
dek.zh: 据报道，台积电正考虑生产先进存储芯片，Groq则谋求80亿美元估值。供应商并购、更严格的芯片流向追踪与系统可靠性改进，显示AI扩张正在重塑供应体系与部署选择。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: IBM, AMD and Oak Ridge Launch a Hybrid Platform for Quantum Error Correction
title.zh: IBM、AMD与橡树岭推出量子纠错混合计算平台

summary.en: IBM, AMD and Oak Ridge have launched a hybrid quantum-classical system to support quantum-error-correction research, EE Times reports. The platform brings classical computing into the error-correction research loop, making coordination between quantum hardware and conventional processors a central systems challenge.
summary.zh: 据EE Times报道，IBM、AMD与橡树岭推出量子与经典计算混合系统，用于支持量子纠错研究。该平台将经典计算纳入纠错研究环节，使量子硬件与常规处理器之间的协同成为系统设计的核心问题。

title.en: PyTorch 2.15 Addresses the Single-GPU Failure Problem in Large Training Jobs
title.zh: PyTorch 2.15着手解决大型训练任务中的单GPU故障问题

summary.en: PyTorch 2.15 addresses the problem of one troublesome GPU disrupting large-scale AI training, The Register reports. The focus on resilience highlights how device faults and software recovery can affect the productive use of expensive accelerator clusters.
summary.zh: 据The Register报道，PyTorch 2.15着手解决单颗异常GPU干扰大规模AI训练的问题。对训练韧性的改进说明，设备故障与软件恢复能力会直接影响昂贵加速器集群的有效利用。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC Considers Making Advanced Memory Chips, Reuters Reports
title.zh: 路透社：台积电考虑生产先进存储芯片

summary.en: TSMC is considering making advanced memory chips, Reuters reports, citing The Information. Such a move could broaden TSMC's manufacturing role in AI systems and change the competitive landscape for established memory suppliers. Any supply-chain impact depends on whether the proposal reaches production.
summary.zh: 路透社援引The Information报道称，台积电正考虑生产先进存储芯片。此举可能扩大台积电在AI系统中的制造角色，并改变现有存储供应商面临的竞争格局。对供应链的实际影响，仍取决于这一设想能否进入生产阶段。

title.en: Community Colleges Expand Training as U.S. Chipmakers Face Labor Constraints
title.zh: 美国芯片业面临用工约束，社区学院扩大半导体培训

summary.en: Community colleges are expanding semiconductor training ahead of a potential labor shortage in the U.S. chip industry, WRAL reports. The effort highlights staffing as a constraint on converting new manufacturing investment into operating production capacity.
summary.zh: 据WRAL报道，面对美国芯片业可能出现的劳动力短缺，社区学院正扩大半导体培训。相关举措表明，能否配齐人员，将影响新增制造投资转化为实际生产能力的进度。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: TrendForce Examines AI Memory Designs Citing 14x HBM Capacity and 3.2 TB per XPU
title.zh: TrendForce探讨AI存储方案：14倍HBM容量与每XPU 3.2 TB

summary.en: TrendForce highlights approaches to AI's memory wall under headline capacity figures of 14x HBM capacity and 3.2 TB per XPU. These figures put memory capacity at the center of accelerator design, while bandwidth, latency and implementation maturity determine the practical benefit.
summary.zh: TrendForce探讨应对AI存储墙的方案，标题列出14倍HBM容量与每颗XPU配备3.2 TB的容量指标。这些数字将存储容量推到加速器设计的核心位置，而实际收益仍取决于带宽、时延与实现成熟度。

title.en: Equipment & Design Tools
title.zh: 设备与设计工具

title.en: G&H Acquires IntraAction to Expand Semiconductor Acousto-Optics Capabilities
title.zh: G&H收购IntraAction，扩充半导体声光技术能力

summary.en: G&H has acquired IntraAction to expand its acousto-optic capabilities for semiconductor applications, Yahoo Finance reports. The transaction combines supplier capabilities in a specialized component segment, making integration and manufacturing execution important to the deal's industrial value.
summary.zh: 据Yahoo Finance报道，G&H已收购IntraAction，以扩充面向半导体应用的声光技术能力。这笔交易整合了专业元件领域的供应商能力，其产业价值将取决于后续整合与制造执行。

title.en: ChipNexus Releases an AI Agent for Existing Analog Design Flows
title.zh: ChipNexus推出面向现有模拟设计流程的AI智能体

summary.en: ChipNexus has introduced NEX Analog Agent for engineering workflows using Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre simulation and Siemens Calibre verification. Available now, the software works with customers' installed tools, licenses and process design kits, bringing conversational automation into established analog design environments.
summary.zh: ChipNexus推出NEX Analog Agent，面向采用Cadence Virtuoso、Spectre仿真与Siemens Calibre验证的工程流程。该软件现已上市，可使用客户已经安装的工具、许可证与工艺设计套件，将对话式自动化引入现有模拟设计环境。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘

title.en: Nvidia Tightens Chip Tracking in Southeast Asia Amid Smuggling Concerns
title.zh: 因担忧芯片走私流向中国，Nvidia加强东南亚芯片追踪

summary.en: Nvidia is tightening AI-chip tracking in Southeast Asia amid concerns about smuggling to China, TechRepublic reports. The move makes downstream traceability a more prominent part of accelerator distribution and puts greater attention on where chips ultimately operate.
summary.zh: 据TechRepublic报道，因担忧芯片经走私流向中国，Nvidia正在加强东南亚地区的AI芯片追踪。此举让下游流向追溯在加速器分销中占据更重要的位置，芯片最终在哪里运行也更受关注。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: Analog Devices Completes Its Acquisition of Alif Semiconductor
title.zh: Analog Devices完成收购Alif Semiconductor

summary.en: Analog Devices has completed its acquisition of Alif Semiconductor, Mexico Business News reports. The closing moves the transaction into the integration phase, where product alignment and execution will determine how much value the combined business creates.
summary.zh: 据Mexico Business News报道，Analog Devices已完成对Alif Semiconductor的收购。交易交割后，工作重心转向业务整合，产品布局的衔接与执行将决定合并后的业务能创造多大价值。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Groq Targets an $8 Billion Valuation Amid the AI Selloff
title.zh: AI板块遭抛售之际，Groq谋求80亿美元估值

summary.en: Groq aims to double its valuation to $8 billion amid an AI-sector selloff, Bloomberg reports. The target would be a test of investor appetite for alternative AI-computing providers during a broader repricing. The reported valuation remains an objective, with completion of a transaction still to be established.
summary.zh: 据Bloomberg报道，在AI板块遭抛售之际，Groq希望将估值翻倍至80亿美元。这一目标将检验板块重新定价期间，投资者对其他AI计算供应商的兴趣。报道中的估值仍是争取目标，相关交易是否完成尚待确认。

theme.en: Efficiency Depends on Devices, Mapping and Scheduling
theme.zh: 效率取决于器件、映射与调度协同

dek.en: Device experiments and measured CMOS prototypes address leakage, memory access and early vision processing, while architecture studies examine mapping and inference partitioning. Quantum scheduling and HLS repair extend the focus to execution efficiency and design productivity.
dek.zh: 器件实验与CMOS原型实测聚焦漏电、存储访问和前端视觉处理，架构研究则考察映射与推理任务拆分。量子调度和HLS修复进一步将效率问题延伸到执行与设计环节。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Fluorine Surface Engineering Tunes HZO FeFET Thresholds and Expands the Memory Window
title.zh: 氟表面工程调节HZO FeFET阈值并扩大存储窗口

papers.authors: Kyungsoo Park, Sangmyun Lim, Sangkuk Han, et al.

summary.en: Fluorine surface treatment shifts the threshold voltage of HZO-based silicon FeFETs positively by about 0.5 V, expands the memory window by about 0.5 V and reduces leakage at 0 V by 40x. The interface treatment enables normally-off operation of the low-threshold state while largely preserving HZO ferroelectric switching. CIFAR-10 accuracy improves from about 78% to 83% in simulations using measured device characteristics, linking the device changes to a modeled inference benefit.
summary.zh: 氟表面处理使HZO基硅FeFET的阈值电压正向移动约0.5 V，存储窗口扩大约0.5 V，并使0 V下的漏电流降至原来的约1/40。该界面处理在基本保持HZO铁电翻转特性的同时，使低阈值态实现常关断。采用实测器件特性的仿真将CIFAR-10分类准确率从约78%提高至83%，表明器件改进可在模型层面带来推理收益。

title.en: Composition-Dependent Atomic Layer Etching Preserves IGZO Electrical Performance
title.zh: 组分相关的原子层刻蚀保留IGZO电学性能

papers.authors: Min Chan Kim, Min-seo Kim, Hyeseong Lee, et al.

summary.en: Hydrogen-based atomic layer etching controls IGZO removal through its elemental composition while largely preserving transistor electrical performance. The near-surface reaction limits channel damage and enables post-deposition trimming inside three-dimensional trenches, improving step coverage to nearly 100%. This provides a process route toward more uniform oxide-semiconductor channels for scaled memory devices.
summary.zh: 研究通过氢基原子层刻蚀，利用IGZO各元素反应活性的差异调节材料去除速率，同时基本保留晶体管电学性能。反应主要局限于近表面区域，可减少沟道损伤，并在三维沟槽中进行沉积后修整，使台阶覆盖率接近100%。这一工艺为缩尺度存储器件获得更均匀的氧化物半导体沟道提供了路径。

title.en: Circuits & Architecture
title.zh: 电路与架构

title.en: A CMOS Vision Sensor Computes Temporal Changes Without Frame Memory
title.zh: 无需帧存储的CMOS视觉传感器实现时域变化计算

papers.authors: Seong-Min Ko, Kishore Kasichainula, Injune Yeo, et al.

summary.en: A 324 × 252 vision-sensor prototype fabricated in 0.18-μm CMOS consumes 4.79 μW at 12.5 frames/s in patch-mode temporal-change processing. A checkerboard pixel architecture and column-shared circuits detect changes without frame memory, while in-pixel time memory supports mixed-signal temporal-derivative computation. The measured design shows how moving initial motion processing into the sensor can reduce memory requirements for low-power vision.
summary.zh: 采用0.18 μm CMOS制造的324 × 252视觉传感器原型，在图像块模式下以12.5帧/秒处理时域变化，实测功耗为4.79 μW。棋盘式像素架构与列共享电路无需帧存储即可检测变化，像素内时间存储电路则支持混合信号时域导数计算。该设计展示了将初步运动处理前移到传感器内部，以降低低功耗视觉系统存储需求的方法。

title.en: Memory Fit Learns Page Affinity for Heterogeneous Server Memory
title.zh: Memory Fit学习内存页亲和性，优化异构服务器存储放置

papers.authors: Chun Deng, Hui Sub Shim, Evan Laufer, et al.

summary.en: Memory Fit supplies the operating system with page-to-memory affinity information by matching access traces against learned models of suitable behavior. The authors implement the abstraction and its soft trace matching algorithm in a BOOMv3 RISC-V processor running Linux 6.6. On extended GUPS, its placements recover 2.2–3.8 times as much of the performance gap to optimal placement as Linux TPP, showing the value of better hardware guidance for heterogeneous-memory management.
summary.zh: Memory Fit将访问轨迹与学习得到的适配行为模型进行匹配，向操作系统提供内存页与不同存储介质之间的亲和性信息。作者在运行Linux 6.6的BOOMv3 RISC-V处理器中实现了这一抽象及其软轨迹匹配算法。在扩展GUPS测试中，其页面放置方案弥合的最优放置性能差距为Linux TPP的2.2—3.8倍，体现了更精细硬件信息对异构内存管理的价值。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: A Valuewise Hybrid-Domain CIM Macro Trades Precision Against Energy
title.zh: 按数值重要性分配计算域的混合CIM宏权衡精度与能耗

papers.authors: Yuan-Zhe Zhao, Yang Wang, Yu-Heng Wang, et al.

summary.en: A 28-nm valuewise hybrid CIM prototype computes a small proportion of the most significant values digitally and processes most values in analog memory arrays. A heterogeneous SRAM/DRAM memory fabric and asynchronous sparsity management address latency and unnecessary activity. Measured energy efficiencies are 470.5 TOPS/W at 4-bit precision, 109.8 TOPS/W at 8-bit and 48.5 TOPS/W at 12-bit, making the precision dependence of the energy benefit explicit.
summary.zh: 这款28 nm按数值重要性划分计算域的混合CIM原型，将少量最重要的数值交由数字电路精确计算，其余大部分数值在模拟存储阵列中处理。异构SRAM/DRAM存储结构与异步稀疏管理用于降低时延和无效活动。实测能效在4位、8位和12位精度下分别为470.5、109.8和48.5 TOPS/W，清楚呈现了能效收益对计算精度的依赖。

title.en: Isobar Models Topology-Aware Mapping for Scaled Analog CIM
title.zh: Isobar为扩展模拟CIM建立拓扑感知映射模型

papers.authors: Yuxin Ren, Danella Zhao, Huanrui Yang

summary.en: Isobar models how weight-mapping topology, heterogeneous execution and resource contention affect analog CIM systems as capacity scales through chiplets. For Gemma-7B prefill, its mapping search reduces modeled communication time by 23.3% and end-to-end latency by 18.6% relative to the strongest baseline. The simulator is validated against silicon measurements and cycle-accurate simulation, providing evidence for mapping decisions while keeping the reported system gains at the simulation level.
summary.zh: Isobar对模拟CIM通过chiplet扩展容量时，权重映射拓扑、异构执行与资源争用如何影响系统性能进行建模。在Gemma-7B预填充任务中，其映射搜索相对最强基线将仿真通信时间降低23.3%，端到端时延降低18.6%。仿真器经过芯片实测与周期精确仿真校验，可为映射决策提供依据，但所报告的系统收益仍属于仿真结果。

title.en: AI Models & Inference Systems
title.zh: AI模型与推理系统

title.en: Splitting Decode Shows No Robust Efficiency Advantage Across Modeled Future Systems
title.zh: 未来系统建模显示：进一步拆分解码未呈现稳健能效优势

summary.en: SiliconForge compares prefill/decode separation with an additional split between attention and feed-forward processing across four model directions, four accelerator classes and two interconnect fabrics. Under a common power budget and optimization rules, the study finds no robust deployment-level advantage for the extra split in SLO-compliant goodput per kW. The analysis shows how added communication and provisioning can offset specialization benefits, with conclusions dependent on modeled workloads and hardware assumptions.
summary.zh: SiliconForge在四类模型发展方向、四类加速器和两种互连网络上，对比预填充与解码分离，以及在此基础上进一步拆分注意力和前馈计算的方案。在相同功率预算与优化规则下，研究未发现进一步拆分能在每千瓦满足SLO的有效吞吐量上获得稳健的部署级优势。分析说明，新增通信与资源池配置开销可能抵消专用化收益，结论仍取决于所建模的工作负载与硬件假设。

title.en: Quantum Computing
title.zh: 量子计算

title.en: DynaMite Selects Measurement Latencies for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Execution
title.zh: DynaMite动态选择测量时延，优化容错量子执行

papers.authors: Dongwhee Kim, Suhas Vittal, Poulami Das

summary.en: DynaMite proposes real-time selection of measurement latency to shorten fault-tolerant quantum programs. The paper identifies qubit measurements as accounting for 43–86% of logical cycle time and argues for scheduling around logical performance rather than relying solely on per-qubit readout calibration. The approach links measurement scheduling to error-correction performance by balancing readout speed, state-discrimination accuracy and decoherence.
summary.zh: DynaMite提出实时选择测量时延的策略，以缩短容错量子程序的执行时间。论文指出，量子比特测量占逻辑周期时间的43%—86%，因此调度应围绕逻辑层性能展开，并将单比特读出校准之外的因素纳入考量。该方法通过权衡读出速度、状态判别准确率与退相干，将测量调度和纠错性能联系起来。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: MementoHLS Uses Verified Repair History to Improve LLM-Generated HLS
title.zh: MementoHLS利用经验证的修复历史改进LLM生成HLS

papers.authors: Xianjing Zhu, Wenqi Lou, Yuanbo Wen, et al.

summary.en: MementoHLS combines reusable repair rules with task-specific revision history to improve LLM generation of functionally correct, synthesizable HLS-C. On 94 HLS-Eval tasks, the rate of candidates passing both testbench and synthesis checks rises from 41.7% to 58.9% at pass@1 and from 57.4% to 68.1% at pass@5. Binding all checks to the same candidate strengthens the evidence for generation success, while these metrics establish correctness and synthesizability rather than final chip performance.
summary.zh: MementoHLS将可复用修复规则与任务内修改历史结合，用于提高LLM生成功能正确、可综合HLS-C的成功率。在94项HLS-Eval任务上，同一候选同时通过测试平台与综合检查的pass@1从41.7%提高至58.9%，pass@5从57.4%提高至68.1%。将所有检查结果绑定到同一候选增强了成功判定的可信度，这些指标衡量的是功能正确性与可综合性，最终芯片性能仍需另行评估。
